trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-intent lead: the customer clicked a Facebook ad to check ZIP eligibility, not to buy solar, and turns out not to be on title to his home. The rep handled the DQ mechanics reasonably (checked ownership, offered a future touchpoint) but missed the emotional beat when the customer disclosed his father-in-law is terminally ill, and the customer flatly rejected being recontacted. This ends as a clean, unsalvageable dead end.
